author: Marta K.
text: We took the 3-hour option and it was just right. The massage was better than I expected for the price.
reply: Thank you, Marta. See you in the winter.

author: Jonas
text: Clean and quiet on a weekday. The pool is small but nobody was in it.

author: Petra and Dan
text: Booked by phone two hours ahead as the voucher says and they had our robes ready.

author: Eliska
text: The cabin smelled of fresh wood and the plunge barrel was properly cold. Ninety minutes went fast.

author: Tom H.
text: Lovely spot. Bring your own slippers, the path to the plunge is gravel.
reply: Good tip, we now lend slippers at the desk.

author: Nina
text: Booked for a birthday. Staff lit the stove before we arrived.

author: Ondrej
text: I didn't think I could switch off for an hour. I did, twice.

author: Sara L.
text: Spotless. The briefing helped, I had no idea what to expect.

author: Mike
text: Great float. Booking online with the code took a minute.

author: Hana
text: The best Thai massage I have had outside Thailand. Book early, they fill up.

author: Robert
text: Ninety minutes and my back finally let go.

author: Ivana
text: Strong hands. Say so if you want it gentler.

author: Klara V.
text: The 7:00 class before work is the best part of my week. Small group, clear teacher.
reply: Thank you, Klara. The terrace is yours.

author: Petr
text: Good class, a bit crowded on Mondays. The tea afterwards is a nice touch.

author: Anna and Tom
text: Two therapists, perfectly in sync. We both fell asleep.
reply: So glad you rested. Come back in the winter.

author: Lukas
text: Very good massage. The room is small but quiet.
